MixBTC mixer

Simply Bitcoin mixer. Try it now

  • Enter your personal payout addresses here. Only Bitcoin addresses are supported. Don't worry, the form will notify you if you entered an invalid address.

  • Specify the amount (at least 20$ as the fee will be paid from this amount) in BTC or USD that you want to mix should the fee be paid, and we will show an alternative in equivalent (since the exchange rate changes every second, it may not be accurate). Random 1% - 5% + 0.0005 BTC

  • The mixing fee ranges from 1% to 5% (the higher the percentage, the greater the anonymity). In addition, a miner fee will be charged, which is required by the crypto network, paid by the user and deducted from the total amount.
  • The transfer delay determines how long it will take for your payments to the specified addresses to begin. In general, the longer the transfer delay, the more anonymous your coins become. With large volumes of transactions, a transfer delay of several hours is recommended.

    • Warning!

    Transaction size should not be less than 20 USD

    Only the first transaction is counted for mixing. The next payments will be ignored.
